chunks: So, O you people, adore your Lord who created you, as He did those before you, that you could take heed for yourselves and fear Him
ai.seo_question: What is the purpose of worshipping the Creator of previous generations?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this foundational verse is often linked to the subsequent verse (2:22) to highlight the progression from general creation to specific providence, reinforcing the concept of Tawhid. It establishes worship not merely as ritual but as the means to cultivate Taqwa, a central virtue in Shia spirituality that entails mindful awareness of God in all aspects of life.
